attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (etcd wasn't previously installed; installed via apt from local cache/mirror since IPv6-only DNS blocked default apt-get), loaded application keys under /app/*, then simulated the permanent loss of node3's member (stopped etcd, wiped its data directory), removed the dead member via etcdctl member remove while node1/node2 kept quorum, added a new member for node3, and started etcd fresh there with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing so it rejoined and fully resynced all application keys. Finished the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery after each.
